specs.title: desktop: the start — middle and end to 0, by the timeline and by Back to start: line 1 at the top, nothing marked, at once
counter-controls: a null line in the middle and leaving the simulation keep the view; a re-entry starts at the top
counter-control: a track without an entry move marks its first line at 0, in view
Back to start never begins a simulation in a run: dimmed like Play; an entry refused starts nothing
